advisories.summary: Storage v2 is the default for new nodes. Existing storage v1 nodes keep working. Storage v1 support will be removed later, with no date set. A v2 datadir cannot be opened as v1.
advisories.action: Leave an existing v1 datadir on v1 until you choose to resync or restore a v2 snapshot. Do not point a v1 binary at a v2 datadir. ExEx users: WAL block encoding changed from bincode to RLP.

advisories.summary: Amsterdam is scheduled on Sepolia. Default RPC cache counts are lower (blocks 5000 to 1000, receipts 2000 to 500). The testing RPC namespace must be selected explicitly. eth_estimateGas honors --rpc.gascap.
advisories.action: Sepolia operators must upgrade before Oct 6, 2026, 13:53:36 UTC. Raise the RPC cache flags if you depended on the old sizes, and enable the testing namespace if you still call it.
